title: skills: objectstack-ai and objectstack-platform still describe the MCP action confirmation gate as a caller confirm; it is now a hand-off to the host service
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

This is the Skills-docs follow-up that PR #34202 (card #33690, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`) owes. These are skills-lane files.

**What changed:** at the MCP door, an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` is no longer run on the caller's `confirm: true`.
- With `IActionConfirmationService` registered, the call is handed to the host and answered `pending_confirmation` with a `pendingId`. Nothing runs.
- With no service, the call is refused 428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `details.reason: no_confirmation_service`.
- An AI service account's refusal carries `details.reason: service_account` at every action door.

**Files:** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` name the gate. Teach the hand-off, the two refusal reasons, and that `confirm` is not read. Exercise them in the evals.

Blocked-by: #34202

Prior rulings read: the #33690 ruling; PR #34202's Skills-docs line.

Dedupe: an open-issue search for "objectstack-ai SKILL.md confirmation" found only #33690.
